limitations: Exploratory comparisons. Whole latency includes network and retries. Added age is a minimum: available buffered snapshots can be older, especially when a synchronous controller blocks observation reads. Actual age at decision and at order issuance are reported separately. Orders are issued/queued, not confirmed to have taken effect. Engine timing has a roughly 0.3 s floor. Visibility-filtered observations are not verified player-equivalent. Active margin counts routing/shattered men as lost but does not weight unit value. Pair intervals use launch means (Student t), not independent rematches. A detectable difference is an approximate 80%-power estimate from the observed SD; a null result does not establish no latency effect. Provider costs can be self-reported. Inspect setup checks, start flags and missing pairs before drawing conclusions.
